name: dependenciesClosed_mono
doc:
(A) **单调性**：扩大合法名集合单调保持闭包自洽。
这是框架的**核心一般结果** —— 它是「补登跨包名即可修复」的正式依据。
proof:
by
  intro u hu d hd
  have hd' : d ∈ LegalNames pkg extra := h u hu d hd
  simp only [LegalNames, List.mem_append] at hd' ⊢
  exact hd'.imp id (fun hx => hsub d hx)

name: dependenciesClosed_of_subset
doc:
(A) **补登引理**：若某包的依赖集整体包含于 `extra`，则它闭包自洽。
这是「把跨包引用名显式登记进 `extra` 即可证明原意」的正式版本。
proof:
by
  intro u hu d hd
  simp only [LegalNames, List.mem_append]
  exact Or.inr (h u hu d hd)

name: dependenciesClosed_of_no_deps
doc:
(A) **空依赖包恒自洽**：没有任何依赖的包对**任意** `extra` 都闭包自洽。
（退化情形，但它是 `dependenciesClosed_of_subset` 的一致性检验。）
stmt:
theorem dependenciesClosed_of_no_deps {pkg : AxiomPackageInstance} (extra : List String)
    (h : ∀ u ∈ pkg.unconstructibles, u.dependencies = []) :
    PackageDependenciesClosed pkg extra
proof:
by
  refine dependenciesClosed_of_subset ?_
  intro u hu d hd
  rw [h u hu] at hd
  simp at hd

name: refPackage_uncs
doc: (A) 辅助引理：`refPackage` 的不可构造问题是其唯一元素。
stmt:
theorem refPackage_uncs :

      [{ name := "continuum_hypothesis", reducesTo := "cardinality",
         dependencies := ["cardinality"], externalRef := "ext", greenVerified := true }]

name: packageDependenciesValid_false
doc:
(A) **§4 核心（负面结果）**：上游原始谓词 `PackageDependenciesValid`
对 `refPackage` **为假**。

∴ 上游那 12 条 `axiom` 所断言的命题**不是「尚未证明」，而是「可判定地为假」**。
这是本项目对上游「0 axiom」承诺的**关键核实结论**，以机器验证形式固化。
stmt:
theorem packageDependenciesValid_false :
    ¬ PackageDependenciesValid refPackage
proof:
by
  intro h
  have hmem : ({ name := "continuum_hypothesis", reducesTo := "cardinality",
                 dependencies := ["cardinality"], externalRef := "ext",
                 greenVerified := true } : UnconstructibleProblem)
              ∈ refPackage.unconstructibles := by
    rw [refPackage_uncs]; exact List.mem_singleton.mpr rfl
  have hdeps := h _ hmem
  have : TemplateNameAvailable refPackage.templates "cardinality" := hdeps _ (by simp)
  simp [TemplateNameAvailable, templateNames, refPackage] at this

name: not_forall_packageDependenciesValid
doc: (A) §4：更强的陈述 —— 上游原始谓词作为「对所有包成立」的**schema 是假的**。

theorem not_forall_packageDependenciesValid :
    ¬ (∀ pkg : AxiomPackageInstance, PackageDependenciesValid pkg)

name: refPackage_closed
doc:
(A) §4：**同一个包**在闭包意义下**为真** —— 说明 (a) 路径确实修复了问题。
（对比 `packageDependenciesValid_false`：只差「补登跨包名」。）
stmt: theorem refPackage_closed : PackageDependenciesClosed refPackage ["cardinality"]
proof:
dependenciesClosed_of_subset (by
    intro u hu d hd
    rw [refPackage_uncs] at hu
    rw [List.mem_singleton] at hu
    subst hu
    simp at hd
    subst hd
    simp)

name: refPackage_false_but_repairable
doc:

这是本项目「公理依赖」议题的可复用模板。

theorem refPackage_false_but_repairable :
    ¬ PackageDependenciesValid refPackage ∧ PackageDependenciesClosed refPackage ["cardinality"]

name: dedupAxioms_length_le
doc: (A) 去重后长度不超过原长度。上游 `dedup_length_le`。
stmt: theorem dedupAxioms_length_le (l : List Axiom) : (dedupAxioms l).length ≤ l.length
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [dedupAxioms]
  | cons a rest ih =>
      simp only [dedupAxioms, List.length_cons]
      have := List.length_filter_le (fun x : Axiom => x.name ≠ a.name) (dedupAxioms rest)
      omega

name: mem_dedup_of_mem
doc:
(A) 去重保留名字：原集中每个公理在去重结果里都有同名对应。
上游 `mem_dedup_of_mem`。真实归纳。
stmt:
theorem mem_dedup_of_mem {a : Axiom} {l : List Axiom} (h : a ∈ l) :
    ∃ b ∈ dedupAxioms l, b.name = a.name
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons c rest ih =>
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at h
      rcases h with hhead | htail
      · subst hhead
        exact ⟨a, by simp [dedupAxioms], rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨b, hb, hbn⟩ := ih htail
                                                           
                                                                    
                                                                       
                                                                         
                                                                         
        by_cases hbc : b.name = c.name
        · exact ⟨c, by simp [dedupAxioms], hbc.symm.trans hbn⟩
        · refine ⟨b, ?_, hbn⟩
          simp only [dedupAxioms, List.mem_cons]
          exact Or.inr (List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hb, by simpa using hbc⟩)

name: mem_of_mem_dedup
doc:
(A) 去重结果中的每个公理都来自原集（**反向**包含）。
上游 `mem_of_mem_dedup`。
stmt: theorem mem_of_mem_dedup {a : Axiom} {l : List Axiom} (h : a ∈ dedupAxioms l) : a ∈ l
proof:
by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [dedupAxioms] at h
  | cons c rest ih =>
      simp only [dedupAxioms, List.mem_cons] at h ⊢
      rcases h with rfl | h
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (ih (List.mem_of_mem_filter h))

name: collinear_of_between
doc: **(A)** 介于蕴涵共线（上游此条有真证明）。
stmt:
theorem collinear_of_between (A B C : LvPoint) (h_bet : between A B C) :
    collinear A B C
proof:
by
  rcases h_bet with ⟨t, _ht0, _ht1, hx, hy⟩
  unfold collinear
  calc
    (B.coord.x - A.coord.x) * (C.coord.y - A.coord.y)
        = (t * (C.coord.x - A.coord.x)) * (C.coord.y - A.coord.y) := by rw [hx]; ring
    _ = (C.coord.x - A.coord.x) * (t * (C.coord.y - A.coord.y)) := by ring
    _ = (C.coord.x - A.coord.x) * (B.coord.y - A.coord.y) := by rw [hy]; ring

name: sq_dist_eq_of_dist_eq
doc: **(B)** 距离相等蕴涵距离平方相等（上游 `sq_dist_eq_of_dist_eq` 有真证明）。
stmt:
theorem sq_dist_eq_of_dist_eq {A B C D : LvPoint} (h : lvDist A B = lvDist C D) :
    (A.coord.x - B.coord.x) ^ 2 + (A.coord.y - B.coord.y) ^ 2 =
    (C.coord.x - D.coord.x) ^ 2 + (C.coord.y - D.coord.y) ^ 2
proof:
by
  unfold lvDist dist at h
  have h1 : 0 ≤ (A.coord.x - B.coord.x) ^ 2 + (A.coord.y - B.coord.y) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have h2 : 0 ≤ (C.coord.x - D.coord.x) ^ 2 + (C.coord.y - D.coord.y) ^ 2 := by positivity
  exact (Real.sqrt_inj h1 h2).mp h

name: circle_inj_implies_noncollinear
doc: **(A)** 同一圆的定义蕴涵共线性质保持不变。
stmt:
theorem circle_inj_implies_noncollinear (A B C D E F : LvPoint)
    (h1 : circle_defined_by A B C = circle_defined_by D E F) (h2 : ¬ collinear A B C) :
    ¬ collinear D E F
proof:
by
  intro hcol
  have h_none : circle_defined_by D E F = none := circle_defined_by_collinear D E F hcol
  have h_none' : circle_defined_by A B C = none := by rw [h1, h_none]
  exact circle_defined_by_noncollinear A B C h2 h_none'

name: classify_point_trichotomy
doc:
**(A)** 分类是**穷尽且互斥**的：任意点恰好落入三类的并。
    这是对上游 `bsp_partition_correctness : True := by trivial` 的**诚实替代** ——
    把 `True` 换成有内容、可证的真命题。
stmt:
theorem classify_point_trichotomy (plane : BSPPlane) (p : Point3D) :
    classify_point plane p = .front ∨ classify_point plane p = .back ∨
      classify_point plane p = .coplanar
proof:
by
  rw [classify_point]
  split
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · split
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)

name: aabb_union_pMin_le
doc:
**(A)** 包围盒并运算是单调的：`aabb_union b1 b2` 的两个角点分别被
    `b1`、`b2` 的角点"夹住"。这是对上游 `csg_aabb_correctness : True := by trivial`
    的**诚实替代**：取其中可证、有内容的单调性部分。
stmt:
theorem aabb_union_pMin_le (b1 b2 : AABB) :
    (aabb_union b1 b2).pMin.x ≤ b1.pMin.x ∧ (aabb_union b1 b2).pMin.y ≤ b1.pMin.y ∧
    (aabb_union b1 b2).pMin.z ≤ b1.pMin.z

name: aabb_union_pMax_ge
doc: **(A)** AABB 并的上界单调性。
stmt:
theorem aabb_union_pMax_ge (b1 b2 : AABB) :
    b1.pMax.x ≤ (aabb_union b1 b2).pMax.x ∧ b1.pMax.y ≤ (aabb_union b1 b2).pMax.y ∧
    b1.pMax.z ≤ (aabb_union b1 b2).pMax.z

name: aabb_contains_union_left
doc:
**(A)** AABB 包含关系对并的单调性（真正有内容的 CSG 性质）：
    点在 `b1` 内则在 `b1 ∪ b2` 内。
stmt:
theorem aabb_contains_union_left {b1 b2 : AABB} {p : Point3D} (h : aabb_contains b1 p = true) :
    aabb_contains (aabb_union b1 b2) p = true
proof:
by
  simp only [aabb_contains, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨h1, h2⟩, h3⟩, h4⟩, h5⟩, h6⟩ := h
  simp only [aabb_union]
  exact ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨le_trans (min_le_left _ _) h1, le_trans h2 (le_max_left _ _)⟩,
    le_trans (min_le_left _ _) h3⟩, le_trans h4 (le_max_left _ _)⟩,
    le_trans (min_le_left _ _) h5⟩, le_trans h6 (le_max_left _ _)⟩


end Lattice.Lv00.Geometry

name: christoffel_depends_only_on_first_fundamental
doc:
**(B)** Christoffel 符号只依赖第一基本形式。
    上游为 `sorry`；此处给出真证明——`christoffel_second` 的定义体中
    除 `first_fundamental` 外无其它自由变量，且差步长是硬编码常量。
stmt:
theorem christoffel_depends_only_on_first_fundamental (S1 S2 : Surface) (u v : ℝ) (i j k : ℕ)
    (h_metric : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, first_fundamental S1 p.1 p.2 = first_fundamental S2 p.1 p.2) :
    christoffel_second S1 u v i j k = christoffel_second S2 u v i j k
proof:
by
  have hE : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (first_fundamental S1 p.1 p.2).1)
          = (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (first_fundamental S2 p.1 p.2).1) := by
    funext p; rw [h_metric p]
  have hF : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (first_fundamental S1 p.1 p.2).2.1)
          = (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (first_fundamental S2 p.1 p.2).2.1) := by
    funext p; rw [h_metric p]
  have hG : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (first_fundamental S1 p.1 p.2).2.2)
          = (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (first_fundamental S2 p.1 p.2).2.2) := by
    funext p; rw [h_metric p]
  have hff : first_fundamental S1 u v = first_fundamental S2 u v := h_metric (u, v)
  unfold christoffel_second
  rw [hE, hF, hG, hff]

name: riemann_depends_only_on_first_fundamental
doc:
**(A)** Riemann 分量只依赖第一基本形式（上游此条有真证明，本文件改用
    `christoffel_depends_only_on_first_fundamental` 所证的同款技术重写）。
stmt:
theorem riemann_depends_only_on_first_fundamental (S1 S2 : Surface) (u v : ℝ)
    (h_metric : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, first_fundamental S1 p.1 p.2 = first_fundamental S2 p.1 p.2) :
    riemann_1212 S1 u v = riemann_1212 S2 u v
proof:
by
  have hE : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (first_fundamental S1 p.1 p.2).1)
          = (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (first_fundamental S2 p.1 p.2).1) := by
    funext p; rw [h_metric p]
  have hF : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (first_fundamental S1 p.1 p.2).2.1)
          = (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (first_fundamental S2 p.1 p.2).2.1) := by
    funext p; rw [h_metric p]
  have hG : (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (first_fundamental S1 p.1 p.2).2.2)
          = (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (first_fundamental S2 p.1 p.2).2.2) := by
    funext p; rw [h_metric p]
  have hff : first_fundamental S1 u v = first_fundamental S2 u v := h_metric (u, v)
  unfold riemann_1212
  rw [hE, hF, hG, hff]

name: theorema_egregium_riemann
doc:
**(A)** Theorema Egregium 的 **Riemann 形式**：Riemann 曲率只依赖第一基本形式
    —— 这正是"高斯曲率是内蕴量"的可证内核。
stmt:
theorem theorema_egregium_riemann (S1 S2 : Surface) (u v : ℝ)
    (h_metric : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, first_fundamental S1 p.1 p.2 = first_fundamental S2 p.1 p.2) :
    gaussian_curvature_riemann S1 u v = gaussian_curvature_riemann S2 u v
proof:
by
  have hR := riemann_depends_only_on_first_fundamental S1 S2 u v h_metric
  have hff : first_fundamental S1 u v = first_fundamental S2 u v := h_metric (u, v)
  unfold gaussian_curvature_riemann
  rw [hR, hff]
